Hi Sophie -

Great questions. Short answers first, then proposed language and next steps below.

Short answers:
- Redwood's standard position: for hosted API customers Redwood operates as a Processor. We are not a Controller for customer data collected and controlled by Acme. If Redwood were to process any customer data for its own purposes (rare and requires explicit agreement), we'd surface that and propose a separate controller/processor carve-out.
- For EU SCCs, the common path here is Module 2 (Controller -> Processor). If Acme sometimes acts as a Processor receiving data from a partner and then sends that onward to Redwood (i.e., Processor -> Processor flows), Module 3 applies for that specific flow.

Proposed next steps and language (to help legal):
1) DPA: the attached draft marks Redwood as Processor and Acme as Controller; Section 2.b clarifies subprocessors and limits. If Acme has any specific data categories that would imply different handling, flag them and we'll update.
2) SCCs: recommend executing Module 2 for the primary data flow (Acme controller -> Redwood processor). If there are documented P->P flows that Acme wants to cover (partner -> Acme -> Redwood), we can include Module 3 as an exhibit or as a conditional clause to be used only when that flow is active.
3) Controller/processor confirmation: Rishi can join a 30-minute legal sync with Liam on Tue 20 Jul 2026 10:00 AM CET - will that work for you? If not, propose two alternative times.
4) Security questionnaire: Drive link is great. Neha will start filling it and will also upload our redacted SOC 2 Type II report (NDA required for full report).

Sample clause to include (plain language for legal):
"For the purposes of the DPA and the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, Acme is the Controller and Redwood Inference is the Processor (Module 2). Where Acme acts as a Processor and transfers personal data to Redwood as part of a Processor-to-Processor relationship, the Parties shall rely on Module 3 for that specific data flow and shall document such flows in an exhibit to the DPA."

Please let me know if you'd like Rishi to review any specific redline in advance of Tue.

Best,
Marissa
